UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the uwsgi bind configuration file to read IP/Port from.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section name in the uwsgi config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the IP address in the config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the port in the config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the number of workers in the config file.

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the uwsgi ini configuration file.

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to the uwsgi application ini file.

UWSGI_BIND_IP.description: IP address for the uwsgi server to bind to.

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user running the vitrage-ml service.

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group running the vitrage-ml service.

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the main vitrage configuration file.

PYARGV.description: Additional python arguments to pass to the daemon.
